queue.instructions: Which team queue this ticket belongs to. Apply intent precedence from the policy: legal > manager > billing > sales > technical. Abstain when the ticket has no interpretable content.

criteria.legal: Lawsuits, subpoenas, compliance, data-breach reports, GDPR/CCPA requests, legal letters
criteria.manager: Explicit escalation ask ('get me a manager', 'complaint to leadership') or repeated-failure frustration
criteria.billing: Charges, refunds, invoices, subscription changes, payment method issues
criteria.sales: Pricing/plan questions from non-customers, demos, upgrade evaluation — 'is X a bug or a plan limit?' is sales

criteria: Normal — how-to, feature request, no impact stated; 'how do I', 'would be nice'
Elevated — real business impact or polite deadline; 'we're blocked', 'needed by Friday', paying-customer complaint

Critical — production outage, data loss/exposure, legal action, chargeback deadline, security incident; 'down', 'lawsuit', 'data leaked'. Does NOT count: a polite deadline or being blocked without business-stopping impact (that's level 1)

vip.instructions: True only on explicit enterprise signals: 'Enterprise plan', 'annual contract', '2000 seats', a named account manager. 'I'm a paying customer' or anger alone does NOT count.
